fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that a silver-coloured smartphone was allegedly snatched from the hand of Mythili Murugan at Anbu Park Main Street by a person who left quickly. The matter was brought to Trichy Central PS on 2025-10-23, while the incident was placed on 2025-10-21 around 18:45 hrs. Lavanya Ammal (9000000175) reported the matter for Mythili Murugan, whose contact number is given as 9000000278. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Murugan Karuppasamy, using the number 9000000309. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly approached from behind and took the phone before leaving the spot.
fields.Keywords: mobile theft, smartphone, mobile number, main street, suspect, evening
